items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: The old man Whiteman, Pops, he was such a good friend of my... Of... Of... Of him was, he wouldn't take me away from him.

ctx.x: Uh, did you know Snoozer Quinn?

I knew Snoozer very well. Snoozer was a great guitarist. I don't have any pictures of Snoozer. He was a great guitarist, and he had a technique of playing guitar, and he'd be shaking hands with somebody and he'd still be playing his guitar with his fingers like that. Uh-huh. And, uh, he was, he went, uh, after, after he was with us, with, out at, uh, Suburban Gardens. Well, he didn't play with the band. He was strictly a soloist. Uh-huh. And he'd go, he'd go over to different tables and play for people at, at, at…
No, I never heard him play fiddle.
